chapter_title: The Explanation of the Peace, what it is; the Righ

spiritual_reading.full_translation:
You have asked about five holy operations. Though they appear among people in a diminished way, they are in themselves great and held in honor, because I can open their hidden depth. These five operations are the inner secret of the Divine good that first went forth from heaven furnished with them, and after its trial returned with them into heaven, where heaven received it.

The first operation is the peace that the whole heaven imparted when the Divine good advanced to meet hell. All heavenly societies were in consort with that advance, surrounding it with companionship, communicating inward tranquility and power, and establishing it in blessed firmness; for such is the peace heaven gives when Divine good goes forth from heaven.

The first communication of power is the strengthening that Divine wisdom gave to Divine good when it advanced into temptation.

The first conjunction of love is the intimate union by which Divine wisdom joined itself to Divine good as it separated into the lower state for trial. All heavenly societies pressed into that union, together with every guardian care and every kindred good and truth within the one heavenly household, because they longed to accompany the saving descent with affection and love.

The first reverent acknowledgment is the humility by which Divine good bowed itself when it entered the lower states. It submitted itself in worship to Divine truth itself and to all heavenly orders within one household, and it petitioned that accompanying power might be granted as it went forth.

The first investiture is the authority and might that Divine wisdom placed upon Divine good. By that empowerment it was armed and made strong, and was sent into spiritual battle. It entered the lower state, carried the struggle through, and brought it to completion against the great aggregated forces and their hostility.

By these five operations the Divine good went forth from heaven against hell, subdued it, and conquered by them.

And by these five it also returned from the conflict into the heavenly kingdom of its own household.

The peace in which it returned is the peace given by the Divine call that proceeds from the inmost Divine; this peace reached it even within hellish obscurity. The peace with which it went down into trial and the peace with which it rose out of it are one in essence; therefore the peace that now exists among the heavenly powers took its form from that same hidden peace, and it is known and received in heaven.

The second communication of power is the empowering that the restoring Divine operation gave when it lifted the Divine good up from temptation; from the inner pattern of that empowering comes the honored practice among people of communicating faithful support and strength to a companion.

The second conjunction of love is the embrace of reunion from the inmost Divine and from Divine wisdom when the Divine good ascended from temptation; from that hidden pattern comes the human practice of joining in affection with companions, whether in separation and distance or in renewed approach.

The second reverent acknowledgment is the worship rendered in due order to Divine truth and to the whole blessed heaven when the inmost Divine and Divine wisdom raised the Divine good out of the lowest distress of trial; from that hidden pattern comes the human practice of honoring companions by humble acknowledgment.

The second investiture is the confirmed conferral of authority when the restoring Divine operation raised the Divine good out of conflict and saved it from the tumult of falsities. It introduced it into ease within its own heavenly societies, established it firmly before the inmost Divine who rules all things, and by this great confirmation made it able to lead kindred goods and truths in a new heavenly state. From this hidden pattern comes the human practice of conferring authority, in which what is greater strengthens what is lesser.

These five hidden operations first existed in the Divine itself. From there people have learned them and set them among themselves in outward forms; but they did not exist at the beginning among hellish powers.

Again, when those who are to be saved are brought forth from natural life, a manifestation of saving good and truth appears before them and redeems them out of evil and falsity into good and truth, establishing peace. This manifestation quiets the person by conjunction of love and by a stilling influx, removing the terrors that arise from hellish persuasions intent on destroying the last order of life. By the clarity of that presence and the recognizable form of mercy, the inner affection of the one being saved is calmed as the person is released from the natural.

Afterwards, the confirming heavenly power that holds the sign of victory communicates support and elevating strength, drawing the spirit out of its lowest entanglement and receiving it into love and peace. The saved one then offers humble acknowledgment to the Divine that redeems; and in that acknowledgment the person is perfected and enlarged according to heavenly ordinance within the society of the living, among angels and all who are in truths from good. Thus the person receives confirmed victory and a state of glory within life that does not end.

paragraph_translations.translation: You have asked about these five lessons. They appear among people in a diminished way, yet in their origin they are great and held in honor, and I can disclose their hidden depth to you. These five signs are the secret order of the Divine good that went forth from heaven furnished with them, and when it had finished its trial it rose again with these same goods confirmed, and heaven received it into its own blessed states.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS: introduces the five operations as the inner pattern of Divine combat and return.

This is the first peace heaven gives when Divine good goes forth from heaven.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Strong coherence: the chapter presents a twofold cycle of five operations—first for the going-forth into temptation, then for the return after victory—and explicitly grounds human gestures as outward forms derived from that inner order. The last paragraph expands the same pattern to the salvation of an individual at the transition from natural life into heaven; despite textual damage, the spiritual sequence remains consistent (manifestation, calming, support, elevation, acknowledgment, perfection, glorification).

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential setup: the five items are presented as ‘miniatures’ in the world but ‘great’ in origin, and are tied to a single functional narrative arc (going-forth/contest/return). No jurisdictional cataloguing or rank-listing intrudes.
findings.evidence: Text: “these five lessons… displayed in the world as miniatures… and yet… great… These five signs are the mystery of the First Man. He came forth with them… when he finished his contest, he went up with these good signs.” Spiritual reading: “introduces the five operations as the inner pattern of Divine combat and return.” The sense arises from what the signs *do* in the narrative (equip descent/enable victory/enable ascent), not from who governs what.

findings.diagnosis: Mostly correspondential, but contains a mild administrative lexical layer (“gods and angels”) that the spiritual reading had to paraphrase to avoid polytheistic literalism. This is not a narrative break; it functions as a collective for ‘heavenly powers’ escorting the First Man.
findings.evidence: Text: “the gods and the angels… gave… peace and power… blessing and fortification… escorting him.” Spiritual reading note: ““Gods and angels” had to be rendered as heavenly societies/powers to avoid polytheistic literalism.” The teaching still works functionally (escort/fortify = what peace does at departure), but the title-like plurals smell like later Manichaean register rather than pure substrate correspondences.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential continuation: ‘right hand’ is treated as a functional act of strengthening bestowed at the moment of descent to contest. No inventorying, no territorial administration.
findings.evidence: Text: “The first right hand is the one that the Mother of Life gave… when he comes out to the contest.” Spiritual reading: “communication of power… strengthening… advanced into temptation.” The meaning arises from the function of the gesture (support/strengthen) at a specific state-change (going out).

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential expansion with one lexical crux (“church tutelaries (?)”) that created a translation workaround, but does not break the narrative. The list of companions is not an administrative roster of ranks; it is an affective scene of embrace at separation.
findings.evidence: Text: “Even all the gods and the angels… were making to embrace him… and the church tutelaries (?), and the kinsfolk…” Spiritual reading note: ““Church tutelaries” is unclear; rendered as guardian care.” The reader stumbled only at a damaged/unclear noun, not at story logic; the passage still performs the functional teaching: affectionately accompanying/strengthening descent.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential: obeisance is framed as a functional interior act (humility/entreaty for escorting power) at the threshold of descent. No administrative jurisdictions.
findings.evidence: Text: “bending his knees… making obeisance… entreating them for a power to escort him.” Spiritual reading: “humility… petitioned that accompanying power might be granted.” The spiritual sense arises directly from action/state (kneeling → humility → request for aid).

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential closure of the first cycle and bridge to ascent: laying on of hands functions as empowerment for battle; then a tight summary (five signs → victory; five signs → return). No seam-expansion detected.
findings.evidence: Text: “She armed him… sent him to the battle… He completed his struggle… By the… five signs… he was victorious… when he ascended… by these five mysteries.” Spiritual reading: “moves from preparation to combat and completion… links… to restoration and return.” Removing any of this would damage the functional arc.

findings.diagnosis: Coherent second-cycle correspondential teaching (descent/peace equals ascent/peace; then right hand/kiss/salutation/laying on of hands as heavenly prototypes for human gestures). However, ¶14 contains a clear administrative inflection at the end: authority is explained as hierarchical governance (“the great giving authority to the lesser”), shifting from functional correspondence to jurisdictional social ordering.
findings.evidence: Text (¶10-¶13) stays prototypical: “appropriate to the mystery… this … has come about… occurs… in the midst of mankind.” The reader did not report narrative break here; they found it “strong coherence.” But ¶14 ends: “as they lay hands on one another, the great giving authority to the lesser.” That clause teaches by rank/governance (administrative logic), not by the function of the gesture itself. The spiritual reading had to restate it as “what is greater strengthens and authorizes what is lesser,” which is still a hierarchical administration model.
findings.scope: “the great giving authority to the lesser.”

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty from damage/fragmentation, not an insertion: the spiritual reading noted forced phrasing (“in time”), but the paragraph still fits the second-cycle template and does not introduce alien names or a new didactic mode.
findings.evidence: Text: “[The] second salutation… made obeisance [in] time… to… all the blessed aeons…” Spiritual reading note: “Text is fragmentary; ‘in time’ and some phrases forced into a coherent spiritual line.” The stumble is philological (gaps), not narrative incoherence; excision would not improve flow.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential meta-summary: origin in the divine → taught to mankind → not originally in darkness. This matches the chapter’s stated purpose (human gestures as miniatures of divine mysteries) and does not shift into an administrative block.
findings.evidence: Text: “came about first in the divine… Mankind has been taught them… instituted them… were not… amongst the powers of darkness.” Spiritual reading: “generalizes from the narrative to origin and transmission.” This is a natural wrap-up of the correspondence claim introduced in ¶2.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential application to individual salvation/after-death ritual sequence; no administrative catalogues. The reader noted damage (“victory prize,” “robe”), but the functional fivefold sequence (peace/kiss/right hand/obeisance/perfection-glory) remains continuous with the chapter’s prototype logic.
findings.evidence: Text: “Light Form… redeems… makes them peaceful… calms… Afterwards… extends… right hand… accepts… with the kiss… That soul shall make obeisance… he shall be perfected… receives the crown… robe of glory.” Spiritual reading note: “Several phrases are damaged… but the through-line is coherent.” The stumble is textual lacunae, not a voice intrusion.

textual_criticism.summary: Findings: 10. The chapter is predominantly correspondential and narratively coherent (two cycles of five gestures, then individual application). Issues: (1) minor mixed-register plurals (‘gods and angels’) that required interpretive smoothing but do not break the story (no action). (2) One localized administrative intrusion at ¶14: the hierarchical governance gloss ‘the great giving authority to the lesser’ shifts from functional correspondence to rank-based administration; excision recommended for that clause only. Two places are genuinely difficult due to damage (¶13, ¶20) but remain coherent; no excision.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: You have questioned me about these five lessons. Now, they are displayed in the world as miniatures, being made little; and yet indeed they are great and honoured. I am the one who can reveal to you their mystery! So, these five signs are the mystery of the First Man. He came forth with them from the aeon of light. Also, when he finished his contest, he went up with these good signs. They received him into the aeons of light.

⟨p.38⟩ The first peace is the one that the gods and the angels in the land of light gave to the First Man; when he comes out against the enemy. The gods and the angels were walking with him; escorting him, giving to him their peace and power, and their blessing and fortification. This is the first peace that the gods and the angels gave to the First Man; as he comes forth from the aeon of light.
The first right hand is the one that the Mother of Life gave to the First Man; when he comes out to the contest.

The first kiss is this one with which the Mother of Life embraced the First Man; as he separates from her, coming down to the contest. Even all the gods and the angels who are in the aeons of light were making to embrace him! [With her] all of them also, and the church tutelaries (?), and the kinsfolk who belong to the household of his people. They were making to embrace him as [he] separates from them, accompanying him out, embracing him with the kiss of affection and love.

⟨p.39⟩ The first salutation is the salutation with which the First Man made obeisance; when he comes out [to the depths] below. He was bending his knees, making obeisance to the God of truth, and all the aeons [of light] who belong to the household of his people; entreating them for a power to escort him, as he comes forth.

The first laying on of hands is the one that the Mother of Life bequeathed upon the head of the First Man. She armed him and made him mighty. She laid hands on him, and sent him to the battle. He descended. He completed his struggle with the great powers and the enmity.
By the [se] five signs and these five myst[e]ri[es] the First Man came forth from the aeons of light against the enemy. He humbled him. He was victorious against him by them.
Also, when he ascended from the war, he came in to the kingdom of the household of his people by these five mysteries!

The peace with which [he ascen]ded is the peace that the summons gave to him, [w]hen it was sent forth from the [Fa]ther of Life. It gave him the peace in the world of darkness. Also, that peace with which he descended is th[e sam]e as the one with which he ascended from the struggle! Therefore, appropriate to the my[s]tery of that peace, which the summons gave the First Man, did this peace here and now come about. It was named and heard among the powers of the Father.

Again, this second right hand is the one that the Living Spirit gave the First Man, when he [brou]ght him upward out from the struggle. Appropriate to [the] mystery [of t]hat right hand this right hand has come about; the one that occurs in the [midst of] mankind, as they give it to their companions, [it b]eing honoured and [glorified]

Also, this second kiss is the one with which the [Father o]f Life and the Mother of the living embraced the First Man, when he ascended from the struggle. Again, this kiss occurs among mankind, as they make to embrace their companions with it; whether then [they] go away from home and be far from their friends, or else [if] they approach one another, according to the mystery of (the First Man).

⟨p.40⟩ [The] second salutation with which the First Man made obeisance [in] time to the God of truth and [all] the blessed aeons and al[l] the aeons [in] whole [land] of light, whe[n] the Father of Life and the Mother of the living brought the Man upward from the abyss of the struggle. Appropriate to the mystery of the second salutation this salutation has come about; this one that occurs today in the midst of mankind, as they make obeisance to one another, doing an honour to their companions.

The second laying on of hands is this: When the Living Spirit brought the First Man upward from the war, he saved him from all the surging waves. He brought him upward, he gave him ease in the great aeons of light, which belong to the household of his people. He set [him] firmly before the Father, the Lord of the totality. He received this great laying on of hands that he may become leader of his brethren in the new aeon. Again, appropriate to the mystery of the second laying on of hands, this laying on of hands has come about; the one that occurs in the midst of mankind as they lay hands on one another.

These five mysteries and these five signs came about first in the divine. Mankind has been taught them; and they have instituted them in their midst [in forms;] these mysteries were not at the beginning amongst the powers of darkness.

Once again: At the time of their coming forth, the Light Form shall come forth before them; and she redeems them from the darkness to the light [and she makes them peaceful.] This Light Form calms the person, with the kiss and her quiet, from fear of the demons w[ho de]stroy his body. By her asp[ec]t and her image [the] heart of the elect one, who is come forth from his bo[d]y, shall be calm for [him]. Afterwards, the angel who h[o]lds the victory prize extends to him the right hand. And it draws him out of the abyss of his body, and accepts him in with the [k]iss and love. That soul shall make obeisance to its red[eem]er, who is this Light Form. And also, at the inst[instant when he makes obeisance,] he shall be perfected and increased according to [the ordinance of the living ones] in the household of the living ones, with the go[ds] and the angel[s] and all the apostles and the chosen. [An]d he receives the crown [and the robe of] glory in the life for ever.

changes_summary: Implemented Finding 7 (¶10–¶14): in ¶14, excised the administrative, rank-governance clause “the great giving authority to the lesser,” leaving the sentence coherent and preserving the correspondential description of laying on of hands. No other changes were made, per all other findings marked “none” or “annotate.”
